whyMatters.en: Reading shoegaze band whose Souvlaki (1993) fixed gentle dual vocals inside thick guitar fog—the softer Creation-era pole opposite MBV’s abrasion.
whyMatters.zh: 雷丁 shoegaze 乐队；Souvlaki（1993）把轻柔双声部放进厚吉他雾——Creation 时期相对 MBV 摩擦感的柔软一极。

shortBio.en: Halstead/Goswell shoegaze; Alison is the Souvlaki entry.
shortBio.zh: Halstead/Goswell shoegaze；Alison 是 Souvlaki 入口。

body.en:
Formed 1989 in Reading. Just for a Day and Souvlaki (with some Brian Eno input) use delay/reverb stacks, whispered dual vocals, and mid-tempo drums rather than noise assault.

Alison (1993) and When the Sun Hits (1993) are the citation pair. 2010s reunion albums confirmed a lasting template for dream-pop revival bands citing UK shoegaze.
body.zh:
1989 年于雷丁组建。Just for a Day 与 Souvlaki（含部分 Brian Eno 参与）用延时/混响堆叠、低语双人声与中速鼓，而非噪声突击。

Alison（1993）与 When the Sun Hits（1993）是引用双曲。2010 年代重组专辑坐实英国 shoegaze 被 dream-pop 复兴乐队持续引用的模板。

note.en: Whispered dual vocals over delay-washed Riff—Souvlaki entry track.
note.zh: 低语双声部叠延时 Riff——Souvlaki 入口曲。

note.en: Volume swell and 延音 wall—Creation-era shoegaze peak dynamics.
note.zh: 音量 swell 与 延音 墙——Creation 时期 shoegaze 峰值动态。

note.en: Pygmalion-era loop and drum-machine drift—softer blur before hiatus.
note.zh: Pygmalion 时期 loop 与鼓机漂移—— hiatus 前更软模糊。

title.zh: MBV 旁的柔软 shoegaze 一极

body.en:
Slowdive matter as the melodic, vocal-forward shoegaze counterweight to My Bloody Valentine’s abrasive Loveless wall.

Souvlaki (1993, Creation) uses delay/reverb 延音 stacks with Halstead/Goswell whisper vocals.

Alison is the gentle entry; When the Sun Hits shows full volume swell.

They prove shoegaze could be mid-tempo and song-shaped, not only noise assault.
body.zh:
Slowdive 要紧处是相对 My Bloody Valentine Loveless 墙的旋律、人声前置 shoegaze 配重。

Souvlaki（1993，Creation）用延时/混响 延音 堆叠配 Halstead/Goswell 低语人声。

Alison 是柔和入口；When the Sun Hits 展示全音量 swell。

证明 shoegaze 可中速、有歌曲形，非仅噪声突击。

body.en:
1989–1995 core: Halstead, Goswell, Chaplin, Scott, Savill—dual vocalist/guitarists with Chaplin bass anchor.

Souvlaki sessions include Brian Eno co-writing input on select tracks.

Pygmalion (1995) shifts toward drum machines and ambient loops before 1995 breakup.

2014 reunion restores Halstead/Goswell with new rhythm section; Sugar for the Pill (2017) updates the blur template.
body.zh:
1989–1995 核心：Halstead、Goswell、Chaplin、Scott、Savill——双主唱/吉他手，Chaplin 贝斯锚。

Souvlaki 录音含 Brian Eno 部分曲目共写。

Pygmalion（1995）转向鼓机与 ambient loop，1995 年解散前。

2014 重组恢复 Halstead/Goswell 加新节奏组；Sugar for the Pill（2017）更新模糊模板。

title.zh: Dream-pop 与 indie 引用链

body.en:
Slowdive’s Souvlaki template—延音 guitar fog plus audible melody—feeds 2010s dream-pop and shoegaze revival acts.

My Bloody Valentine and Sonic Youth are direct ancestors; Slowdive softens the attack.

Radiohead’s mid-90s textural interest shares the same UK indie infrastructure.

Reunion records prove the method outlasted Creation’s original run.
body.zh:
Slowdive Souvlaki 模板——延音 吉他雾加可闻旋律——喂养 2010 年代 dream-pop 与 shoegaze 复兴。

My Bloody Valentine 与 Sonic Youth 是直接祖先；Slowdive 软化攻击。

Radiohead 1990 年代中期质感兴趣共享同一英国 indie 基建。

重组唱片证明方法比 Creation 原运行更长寿。
